content.en: Scientists are using algorithms to help identify high-performing metal-organic frameworks for various applications, such as methane purification, carbon capture, and gas separation. These algorithms, including quantitative structure-property relationship models, machine learning techniques, and computational screening, are able to analyze large amounts of data and make predictions about the performance of different frameworks. By combining computational analysis with experimental studies, researchers hope to discover new materials that can improve processes like methane storage, CO2 capture, and gas separation.
content.da: Forskere bruger algoritmer til at hjælpe med at identificere højtydende metal-organiske rammer til forskellige anvendelser, såsom methanrensning, CO2-fangst og gasadskillelse. Disse algoritmer, herunder quantitative structure-property relationship-modeller, machine learning-teknikker og computational screening, er i stand til at analysere store mængder data og lave forudsigelser om ydeevnen for forskellige rammer. Ved at kombinere computational analyse med eksperimentelle studier håber forskere at opdage nye materialer, der kan forbedre processer som methanlagring, CO2-fangst og gasadskillelse.

critic.en: Here we go again – a utopia where algorithms solve all our problems. Do you really think that just by "quantitative structure-property relationship models" and a sprinkle of machine learning magic, we can effortlessly solve gigantic issues like carbon capture and methane purification? What about accountability and long-term responsibility?
critic.da: Ah, endnu et skrækkeligt eksempel på algoritmernes ubetingede sejr! Hvis jeg tuber med en datamaskine, betyder det så også, at jeg er en bedre skuespiller? Nej tak!

potential.en: It's amazing to see how scientists are leveraging algorithms and computational tools to accelerate the discovery and optimization of metal-organic frameworks. The ability to analyze large amounts of data and make targeted predictions has the potential to revolutionize the development of new materials for applications in methane purification, carbon capture, and beyond. I believe that this work not only showcases the power of collaboration between the fields of materials science and computer science but also highlights the transformative impact that technology can have on addressing key environmental and societal challenges.
potential.da: For det første er det ret spændende at se, hvordan algoritmer bliver brugt til at identificere og optimere metal-organiske rammer. Jeg kan godt lide tanken om at kombinere beregninger med eksperimenter for at finde frem til nye materialer, der kan forbedre klimarelaterede processer.
